The Program Manager (Branch Manager for Field Services) in the Real Estate Management Division, Facilities and Administration, Mission Support, Transportation Security Administration (TSA), Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

Duties include but are not limited to: Duties include: Provides overall leadership and supervision for the division, including planning, communicating vision and objectives, setting priorities, managing budget and resources, recruiting and developing staff, approving leave, and taking corrective/disciplinary actions.

Ensures workforce alignment with organizational goals and manages a multi-sector workforce. Leads, directs, and exercises broad authority over all phases of real estate management policies, strategic planning, and program operations for TSA.

Provides innovative leadership in establishing and implementing comprehensive real estate management strategies. Oversees activities related to TSA's leased and owned real estate portfolios, including lease acquisition, administration, facilities operations and maintenance, construction, and real estate disposition.

Supervises a team of Realty Services Managers (RSM) who direct, implement, coordinate, and oversee a national real estate program requiring a wide range of management support principles, processes and systems. The RSMs manage initiations and renewals of leases, which require a complex process of negotiations between and approvals by the parties.

Provides oversight and management direction for contracted functions, ensuring efficient and effective use of public and private resources in support of TSA's mission.

Implements policies and procedures to reduce TSA's real estate footprint through space consolidation and utilization, and operational costs by deploying energy efficiency tools, consistent with OMB guidance.

Collaborates with TSA office directors and interacts with senior leaders within TSA, DHS, GSA, and service providers to ensure operational facility requirements are prudently executed and managed.

Administers a diverse, enterprise-wide real estate portfolio, ensuring full compliance with federal leasing regulations, lease expirations, and portfolio performance metrics. Manages and executes over 500 GSA leases, ensuring terms are negotiated in the best financial interest of the agency.

Navigates the GSA Reimbursable Work Authorization process, ensuring accurate funding data, budget tracking, and timely execution of tenant improvement projects. Provides proactive, outstanding customer service and real estate solutions to field real estate locations, addressing space requirements and facility concerns and improvements.

Conducts special real estate projects and complex analyses, as assigned by the Director, requiring a comprehensive knowledge of program management. Supervisory/Managerial duties includes serving as a first line supervisor for the organization.

This includes but is not limited to: assigning work, setting priorities, and reviewing and evaluating work and performance of subordinates; approving leave; coaching and developing employees; recommending corrective or disciplinary actions; assisting in budget planning and projecting short-term needs; managing projects within assigned resources; resolving routine problems that typically impact the objectives of the organizational unit; and when required, coordinating with customers outside the immediate organization.
To qualify for the SV-K Pay Band (equivalent to GS-15), you must have one year of specialized experience at the SV-J or GS-14 in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private sector.

Specialized experience is defined as experience that has equipped you with the knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position.

Specialized experience is defined as: Knowledge of federal laws, regulations, policies, and procedures related to real estate management, leasing, facilities operations, and asset disposition. Experience in managing multi-layered, geographically dispersed organizations with varied missions and functional requirements.

Credit for experience is given based on a 40-hour workweek. Part-time experience is credited on a part-time ratio, i.e., working 20 hours per week for two months equals one month of experience. No additional credit is given for overtime.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

​Gemeinsam mit unserem Mandanten, einem mittelständischen Münchener Unternehmen im verfahrenstechnischen Anlagenbau , besetzen wir in München die Position
​​
Projektleiter* / Projektingenieur*
​******** ​ Sie verbinden technische Kompetenz mit wirtschaftlichem Denken und sorgen dafür, dass anspruchsvolle Komponenten und Prozesse zuverlässig, effizient und in hoher Qualität in die Serienproduktion überführt werden.
Aufgaben
​ Planung und Engineering von Serienkomponenten einschließlich technischer Auslegung und Begleitung der Implementierung
Erstellung von Kostenkalkulationen, Angeboten und technischen Bewertungen
Durchführung von Herstellbarkeitsanalysen (Einzel bis Kleinserie)
Optimierung von Herstellungs- und Prozesskosten sowie Verkürzung von Vorlauf- und Durchlaufzeiten
Bearbeitung technischer Reklamationen und Anweisung geeigneter Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen
Sicherstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des QM-Systems unter DIN ISO 9001
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, Einkauf, Produktion, Logistik und Qualitätssicherung
Koordination und Abstimmung mit nationalen und internationalen Stakeholdern, Kunden und Projektpartnern
Technische Betreuung bestehender Kunden sowie Unterstützung beim Aufbau neuer Kundenbeziehungen
Unterstützung bei der Übernahme, Industrialisierung und Umsetzung neuer Projekte
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement und in der eigenständigen Projektdurchführung
Abgeschlossenes Studium der Verfahrenstechnik, Fertigungs- oder Produktionstechnik, des Maschinenbaus, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Sicherer Umgang mit technischen, wirtschaftlichen und qualitätsbezogenen Anforderungen in Serienprojekten
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit nationalen und internationalen Projektpartnern, Kunden und Stakeholdern
Technisches Verständnis im verfahrenstechnischen Anlagenbau
Erfahrung mit Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards sowie QMS - insbesondere ISO 9001
Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung, beispielsweise nach IPMA, PMI oder PRINCE2
Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge strukturiert zu bewerten und verständlich zu vermitteln
Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung und ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Verbindlichkeit und wirtschaftlichem Denken
Sehr gute Deutsch und Englischkenntnisse (je ab B2) in Wort und Schrift
​
​
Was die Stelle interessant macht
​
Diese Position verbindet anspruchsvolles Engineering mit konkretem Einfluss auf industrielle Umsetzung. Sie begleiten Projekte von der technischen Bewertung bis zur erfolgreichen Überführung in die Serienproduktion und können Herstellbarkeit, Qualität, Kosten und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.
Dabei arbeiten Sie nicht nur an technischen Detailfragen, sondern übernehmen Verantwortung an zentralen Schnittstellen des Unternehmens. Sie koordinieren unterschiedliche Fachbereiche, stimmen sich mit nationalen und internationalen Kunden, Stakeholdern und Projektpartnern ab und tragen dazu bei, neue Projekte wirtschaftlich und technisch erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Die Aufgabe bietet damit ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld für erfahrene Ingenieure, die technische Tiefe, Projektverantwortung, Kundenkontakt und internationale Zusammenarbeit miteinander verbinden möchten.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting. We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us.

Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here. Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve. Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard. Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait. Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts. Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together. We look forward to welcoming your application. Medicine moves forward here. So will you. At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job.

The Department of Energy's mission is to ensure America's security and prosperity by addressing its energy, environmental and nuclear challenges through transformative science and technology solutions.

The Office of Technology Commercialization office works to develop and oversee the delivery of the Department of Energy's strategic vision and goals for technology commercialization and engagement with the business and industrial sectors across the United States.

We are truly honored that DOE has been named America's #1 Best Employer for Veterans in 2023 by Forbes-not only among Government agencies, but among employers across the U.S. We are so proud of this ranking which reflects our commitment to the employment of veterans.

As so many veterans at DOE renew their service to our Nation, we are deeply committed to their success and advancement.

Veterans shape the future of energy As a Commercialization Program Manager, you will: Organize and administer technology commercialization programs, to include the Technology Commercialization Fund (TCF), to transition laboratory research into the commercial market.

Serve as a senior technical advisor in physical sciences and engineering to evaluate the technical feasibility, maturity, and risks of proposed energy technologies and commercialization projects. Analyze technology-to-market programs to assess their effectiveness, identify performance barriers, and recommend strategic improvements.

Foster collaborative partnerships and coordinate initiatives among national laboratories, plants, sites, other federal and state agencies, and private-sector stakeholders. Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets to ensure milestones are met and program resources are managed efficiently.

Prepare and deliver technical briefs, reports, and presentations to explain complex scientific and engineering concepts and justify program recommendations to senior leadership and external groups.
BASIC REQUIREMENT: You must meet both the Basic Requirement and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this series as described below. A.

Degree: physical science, engineering, or mathematics that included 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science such as mechanics, dynamics, properties of materials, and electronics. OR B.

Combination of education and experience: education equivalent to one of the majors shown in A above that included at least 24 semester hours in physical science and/or related engineering science, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-12 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting 2 of the following 3: Provide guidance on technology commercialization, lab-to-market funding programs, energy end-use sectors, or technology maturation processes that advance program objectives.

Act as a technical point of contact to build consensus among corporate partners, research facilities, academic institutions, Tribal organizations and DOE National Laboratories for all joint technology commercialization projects.

Assist with writing briefing materials or reports that are used by management to develop technical recommendations that advance technology commercialization objectives. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience.

Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Limit your resume to no more than two (2) pages.

If more than two pages are submitted, only the first two pages will be reviewed to determine your eligibility and qualifications. Your full resume will be made available to the hiring manager if you are referred.

Time-in-Grade: Current Federal employees must meet time-in-grade requirements by the closing date of this announcement to receive consideration and current employees must have at least a fully successful or equivalent performance rating to receive consideration.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

You will provide government leadership, oversight and interface with supported MOCs and their respective CCMDs for maritime requirements in OL exercises and training.

You will hear and resolve complaints, conduct minor disciplinary measures and refer more serious, unresolved complaints to higher levels.
You will identify developmental and training needs and find eliminate and/or reduces significant bottlenecks to process improvement, promoting team building and improving business practices.
To qualify for the GS-15, in addition to the Basic Requirements for this position, your resume must also demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-14 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Extensive experience in the design, development, scenario scripting, modeling and simulation, and exercise control facets of Operational Level (OL) and Large Scale Exercises (LSE) (e.g., CCMD exercises, USAF BLUE FLAG, USMC MEFEXs, or US ARMY Advanced Warfighter Exercises) utilizing live, virtual, and constructive (LVC) training environments.

Mastery-level knowledge and extensive operational experience utilizing the Navy Planning Process (NPP) and the Joint Operational Planning and Execution System (JOPES) to plan and execute joint and maritime military operations.

Direct experience serving on a numbered/major Fleet staff or Combatant Command (CCMD)/Joint Task Force (JTF) staff, with deep-seated knowledge of Navy missions, organizational structures, and command relationships (ADCON, OPCON, TACON) executed during CCDR operations.

Proven experience serving as a team lead supervising a diverse workforce (including GS civilians, active-duty military up to O-6, and contractors) and managing significant programmatic resources, including POM submissions, travel budgets, and service labor contracts in excess of $6M per annum.

Exceptional oral and written communication skills to facilitate high-stakes discussions, present critical risk-benefit analyses, and negotiate solutions on contentious issues with Flag/SES-level leaders, 3- and 4-star Fleet Commanders, and senior joint or international stakeholders.

The Pharmacy Inventory Manager is responsible for providing leadership, direction, coordination, clinical guidance, organization, planning, and implementation of pharmaceutical procurement throughout the VA Northern California Healthcare System.

Major Duties include but are not limited to the following: Program Management: Coordinates all activities related to procurement and inventory of all medications, supplies and IV fluids for pharmacy services to include but not limited to receiving, stocking, maintaining inventory, establishing maximum/minimum levels for ordering and automation, rotating stock to minimize expiration and under/overstock, borrowing, returns and destruction.

Monitors and regularly reports status of pharmacy expenditures identifying significant changes, including data and information on specific drugs, therapeutic classes, supplies, etc., that have contributed to the change. Maintains knowledge and competency to appropriately carry out all purchase card duties.

Coordinates with relevant stakeholders and other pharmacy staff to create action plans for drug recalls, shortages, and backorders.

Maintains proficiency in software programs and internet resources related to purchasing, inventory and pharmaceutical care including but not limited to facility automation, electronic health record, prime vendor and other vendor resources, reverse distributor, Federal government, VHA, CMOP, VISN, and local medical center resources, medication dispensing and distribution, drug accountability, controlled substances, IFCAP, vendor files, Fund Control, GIP, purchasing agent menus etc.

Use of Government Credit Cards/Approving Official: Ensures all cardholders and approving officials complete mandatory training. Assures all cards are used appropriately, and/or takes appropriate action when misuse/abuse of purchase card occurs. Establishes cards within the limits of delegated purchase authority.

Immediately cancels card assigned to any employee who separates or is transferred. Assures reconciliation and approvals are completed within the mandated timeframe. Ensures reconciliation is completed prior to a cardholder taking leave or leaving the service. Verifies cardholders perform appropriate market research prior to purchasing.

Ensures proper documentation of records. Certifies all procurements are legal and appropriate. Certification of inappropriate procurements will result in immediate revocation of approving authority, possible disciplinary action and/or issuance of a bill of collection for the full cost of the procurement.

Certifies reconciled (matched) payment charges in IFCAP within 10-days of receipt from cardholder. Administration: Strives to increase productivity and efficiency of assigned personnel and other Pharmacy Service activities to improve processes and pharmaceutical care provided to patients.

Communicates effectively with employees, keeping them informed of necessary information; keeps in close communication with each Section Supervisor regarding drug procurement, drug use, drug accountability, drug budget, etc.

Ensures implementation of pharmacy-based action items as they relate to the facility Pharmacy and Therapeutics (P&T) Committee functions and activities. Assists in meeting all Joint Commission medication management standards by having an expert understanding of regulatory and quality standards for the area of practice.

Ensures accuracy, validity, and timely submission of pharmacy workload activity reports, systematic review/performance improvement reports, operations reports, drug utilization/data reports, and other special reports that are pertinent to the incumbent's program areas.

Research: Participates in the development of protocols for research projects for the Pharmacy Services as appropriate. Enables appropriate distribution of research project information to involve personnel to facilitate the proper handling and use of investigational drugs as appropriate.

Enforces policies and procedures regarding the proper handling, storage, record keeping, and dispensing of investigational drugs, as well as relevant patient monitoring as appropriate for the assigned Pharmacy Section.

Participates in developing criteria for drug utilization evaluations, data collection, trending reports, and other quality assurance activities as required ensuring appropriate and safe drug utilization. Work Schedule: Mon-Fri: 8:00am to 4:30pm Telework: Ad-Hoc Only Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

The clinical pharmacy specialist (CPS) functions at the highest level of clinical practice, works independently under their scope of practice as defined by the individual medical center to directly care for patients.

A CPS plays a defined role in budgetary execution and serves as a mid-level provider who functions to initiate, modify or discontinue medication therapy and as a consultant for intensive medication therapy management services.

This includes, but is not limited to, the following: designing, implementing, assessing, monitoring and documenting therapeutic plans utilizing the most effective, least toxic and most economical medication treatments; helping achieve positive patient centric outcomes through direct and indirect interactions with patients, providers, and interdisciplinary teams in assigned areas; performing physical assessments; and ordering laboratory and other tests to help determine efficacy and toxicity of medication therapy.

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.
Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met.

Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.
As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.
What you'll own
Onboarding projects
Build and own the project plan for each new laboratory, from kickoff to go-live, with dependencies and dates kept current.
Direct the work across our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and the customer's staff.
Accompany the validations customers run as part of onboarding. The laboratory's medical director designs the study; you make sure the technical setup is correctly installed and working, that our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and that the customer has everything they need to complete it.
Carry the committed go-live date, and raise risks early with options rather than after a slip.
Customer success after go-live
Act as the customer's main point of contact once live, monitoring usage and engagement and reaching out proactively.
Own incoming support requests: resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop with the customer.
Bring what you learn from customers into product planning, and flag potential expansion opportunities to Sales where relevant.Bring what you learn from customers into product planning.
You do not carry a sales target. But flagging expansion opportunities to Sales is part of your responsibility.
How you'll start
You will take on real customer onboarding projects from the start and lead them yourself, with close support from the team and from your manager in the beginning. As you build familiarity with our products and our customers, you move into running them independently.
Your Profile
A degree in biology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, medicine, or a related field.
3+ years leading projects with external customers — clinical or diagnostic implementation, digital pathology, medical device or laboratory rollout, health IT deployment, or comparable delivery work.
Proven ability to build a realistic project plan and drive it to a date, updating it responsibly and transparently as things change.
Proven ability to direct people inside and outside the company.
Technically confident: able to discuss interfaces, integrations and data credibly with ML engineers and IT staff, instruct them clearly, and translate between them and the customer.
Able to hold a room with a laboratory director, a pathologist and an IT lead, and keep all three aligned.
Full professional proficiency in English. German is not required.
Based in Hamburg, or willing to relocate, and working on-site with the team.
Willing to travel to customer sites internationally — occasional trips, typically a few times a year, focus on US customers.
Comfortable with the occasional late-afternoon or early-evening call to overlap with customers in other time zones.

Experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments, or a background in the natural sciences.
If you have not worked in pathology: evidence that you have become competent in an unfamiliar technical domain before.
Experience working within a quality management system, or delivering software into a regulated clinical setting.
Commercial instinct.
Why Mindpeak
Our vision is personalized, effective cancer treatment for every patient.
Build foundational AI systems that power both clinical cancer diagnostics and data-driven drug development, and actively shape the future of personalized medicine.
An open, creative environment with flat hierarchies and fast decisions.
A leadership team that invests in continuous development.
A centrally located Hamburg office with a spectacular view over the harbor.

**About Syngenta**
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges.

We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact.

Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. **Syngenta has been ranked as a-top employer-by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.**
## Job Description ##
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, we are seeking a **Global Environmental Technology Lead**. This is a hybrid role based primarily in Muttenz, Switzerland, though Monthey can also be considered.
As Global Environmental Technology Lead, you will shape how Production & Supply identifies, develops and deploys the technologies that reduce environmental impact while protecting operational performance and our license to operate.

This is a high-impact global role for an accomplished scientist or engineer who can move confidently between technical depth, strategic direction and practical implementation. You will connect manufacturing sites, process development, environmental specialists and external partners to turn complex environmental challenges into scalable solutions.

* Set the global environmental technology strategy across waste, wastewater, air emissions, vent treatment, recovery and recycling, informed by Best Available Techniques (BAT).
* Identify, assess and mature emerging technologies, taking opportunities from laboratory and pilot-scale evidence through to robust manufacturing application.
* Partner with global and local manufacturing teams to solve critical environmental challenges, improve site performance and safeguard license to operate.
* Provide technical leadership and independent challenge for environmental projects, assessing feasibility, environmental benefit, risk, operability and cost.
* Influence product and process choices early by evaluating waste streams, especially wastewater, during active-ingredient process development.
* Develop practical, high-value solutions that reduce impacts to air, water and land across existing products and manufacturing sites.
* Build and lead a connected global environmental technology community spanning Technology & Engineering, Production & Supply, Environmental Managers, process development teams and external experts.
* Grow internal capabilities through technical coaching, knowledge exchange, training, literature reviews and partnerships with suppliers, consultants and technology providers.
* Translate complex environmental science and regulation into clear choices and decisive action for technical and business stakeholders.

* Master-s degree, or equivalent, in Chemistry, Chemical Process Engineering or a related discipline.
* Ideally 10+ years- experience in industrial chemical operations and/or process development.
* Demonstrated expertise in environmental technologies and a practical understanding of environmental legislation.
* Able to remain focused, resilient and effective in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Strong knowledge of waste, wastewater, emissions, recovery and recycling technologies.
* Solid grounding in organic and inorganic chemistry, chemical processes and process engineering; agrochemical production knowledge is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of environmental toxicity, chemical bio-transformation and environmental risk assessment.
* Proven ability to lead teams or workstreams in project, departmental or matrix environments.
* Experience in project and change management, with resilience in ambiguous environments.
* Strong analytical, conceptual, organisational and negotiation skills.
* Clear communication and stakeholder-influencing skills at all levels.
* Experience working across multicultural, multinational teams, with a recognised record of technical delivery.
* Fluent business English; French is highly advantageous.

Ausgangslage
Die Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung Luzern und Subito Kriseninterventionen entwickeln im Auftrag des Kantons Luzern ein neues traumapädagogisches, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot.

Das Angebot richtet sich an Kinder, Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene bis maximal 25 Jahre mit stark belastenden Bindungs- und Beziehungserfahrungen sowie herausfordernden Verhaltensweisen, für die bestehende stationäre Wohnformen oder Pflegeverhältnisse nicht ausreichend tragfähig sind.

Ziel ist es, dass die Kinder und Jugendlichen im Zuhause eines Menschen mit Ausbildung im Sozialbereich leben, der diese Aufgabe als Haupterwerb übernimmt und zusätzliche Unterstützung von weiteren Menschen aus dem eigenen sowie professionellen Umfeld erhält.
Die erste Projektphase vom 1. Januar 2027 bis 31. Dezember 2027 dient dazu, die fachlichen und organisatorischen Grundlagen sorgfältig zu entwickeln und die Umsetzung ab 2028 vorzubereiten. Dafür suchen wir eine initiative, verbindende und fachlich starke Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, Neues aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und traumapädagogisches Wissen wirksam in die Praxis zu übersetzen.
### Funktion ###
Projektleitung Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung
### Pensum ###
30 %
### Dauer ###
Vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2027. Es besteht die Option einer Verlängerung bei Abschluss der ersten Projektphase.
### Projektziel ###
Aufbau des neuen Angebots: Erarbeitung von Konzept und Kooperationsgrundlagen, Rekrutierung und Anstellung von Betreuungspersonen, allgemeine Vorbereitung der Leistungserbringung, Zusammenarbeit mit externen Anspruchsgruppen aufbauen
### Arbeitsfeld ###
Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Traumapädagogik, Pflegekinderwesen, stationäre Intensivbetreuung im familiären Umfeld
Deine Aufgabe
In der Rolle Projektleitung gestaltest du die Aufbauarbeit eines innovativen Angebots mit hoher fachlicher und gesellschaftlicher Bedeutung. Du entwickelst tragfähige Grundlagen, steuerst den Projektprozess, vernetzt zentrale Partnerinnen und Partner und bringst traumapädagogische Expertise so ein, dass ab 2028 ein wirksames, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot starten kann.
Deine Hauptaufgaben konkret
* Aufbau der Projektorganisation mit den beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung und Subito Kriseninterventionen und weiteren relevanten Anspruchsgruppen inkl. Leitung eines Projektteams
* Entwicklung des Konzepts für die traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung unter punktuellem Einbezug externer traumapädagogischer Expertise und in Zusammenarbeit mit den zukünftigen Betreuungspersonen
* Definition der Aufnahme- und Ausschlusskriterien sowie der konkreten Leistungsinhalte
* Erarbeitung einer tragfähigen Lösung für die Tagesstruktur, falls vorübergehend kein Schulplatz vorhanden ist
* Aufbau der Zusammenarbeit mit der Luzerner Psychiatrie und Erarbeitung einer Kooperationsvereinbarung
* Ausarbeitung der Stellenbeschriebe und Rekrutierung des künftigen Betreuungspersonals, gewünscht ist eine frühzeitige Einbindung der hauptbetreuenden Person in die Konzeptentwicklung
* Vorbereitung der Arbeitsverträge und weiterer Anstellungsunterlagen für Betreuungspersonen unter Einbezug juristischer Expertise
* Aufgleisung der fachlichen Unterstützung für die Betreuungspersonen, insbesondere Gruppensupervision
* Bekanntmachung des Projekts bei wichtigen zuweisenden Stellen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Leitungen der beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen
* Entwicklung von Instrumenten für die Auswertung der zweiten Pilotprojektphase sowie einer Struktur für den ausführlichen Zwischenbericht
* Erstellung des Berichts zur ersten Projektphase zuhanden der DISG/KOSEG inklusive Zustellung des Konzepts für das Leistungsangebot
Das bringst du mit
Wir suchen eine reflektierte, mutige und verbindende Persönlichkeit, die Freude und Leidenschaft für innovative Pionierarbeit mitbringt. Besonders relevant für diese Aufgabe sind:
* Ausbildung in Sozialer Arbeit, Sozialpädagogik, Heilpädagogik, Psychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, idealerweise im stationären Bereich oder im Pflegekinderwesen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Traumapädagogik, Bindungstheorie und traumasensibler Beziehungsgestaltung
* Erfahrung in Projektleitung, Konzeptentwicklung und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
* Bereitschaft zu einer gleichwertigen Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und Freude an partizipativen Entscheidungs- und Arbeitsformaten
* Sicherheit und Eigenständigkeit im schriftlichen Arbeiten, in der Berichterstattung, im Umgang mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln und im Aufbau fachlicher Grundlagen
* Hohe Selbständigkeit, eine sehr gute Arbeitsorganisation und Freude daran, aus Ideen konkrete nächste Schritte zu entwickeln
* Kommunikationsstärke, Vernetzungsfähigkeit und die Gabe, unterschiedliche Akteurinnen und Akteure konstruktiv einzubinden
Das bieten wir
* Eine sinnstiftende Projektaufgabe mit grosser fachlicher, gesellschaftlicher und menschlicher Relevanz
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und eine hohe fachliche Autonomie beim Aufbau eines neuen kantonalen Pilotangebots
* Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Organisationen und Fachpersonen der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Fachlichen Austausch mit traumapädagogischer Expertise
* Sehr flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Rahmen des Projektauftrags
* Die Möglichkeit, Grundlagen für ein spezialisiertes Angebot mit nachhaltiger Wirkung zu schaffen
* Option auf längerfristige Rolle bei erfolgreicher Pilotphase
Worum es im Angebot geht
Im Zentrum des künftigen Angebots steht eine bewährte Idee aus dem nahen Ausland: Eine sozialpädagogische Fachperson stellt ihr eigenes Zuhause für die längerfristige Betreuung eines Kindes zur Verfügung und wird dafür in einem 100-Prozent-Pensum angestellt.

Sie wird von Menschen aus ihrem persönlichen Umfeld sowie von professionellen Unterstützungspersonen begleitet und entlastet. So entsteht ein tragfähiges Netz rund um das Kind und die betreuende Fachperson. Das Angebot verbindet Kontinuität, verlässliche Beziehungen, Schutz, Partizipation und traumasensible Begleitung.

Kinder und Jugendliche sollen einen äusseren und personalen sicheren Ort erleben, korrigierende Beziehungserfahrungen machen und gemeinsam mit Fachpersonen neue Handlungsroutinen entwickeln können.
Stellenantritt und weiteres Vorgehen
Der Stellenantritt ist per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung vorgesehen.
Hast du Lust, diese Pionierarbeit mitzugestalten? Dann freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören. Für Auskünfte stehen dir Michelle von der Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung (041 318 50 60) und Jonas von Subito (041 261 02 66), gerne zur Verfügung.

The APM will handle multiple projects simultaneously at various stages of development and construction progress. Projects will either be in a pre-determined region or customer-based and spread throughout the country.

This division acts as the premobilization support to Ampacity clients and their subcontractors by organizing deliveries, analyzing the realizability of accelerations and shipping holds, coordinating change orders, and advising on the engineering build and best practices.

An Associate Project Manager in this regard should be able to manage the communication, balance the differing needs, and be resourceful in the approach to solving issues for a multitude of clients. Specialized Experience GS-14: One year of specialized experience which includes:1) planning and executing complex Information Technology (IT) projects by developing detailed project plans, schedules, and milestones; 2) managing IT program execution by tracking progress, controlling cost and schedule, and reviewing contractor deliverables to ensure alignment with objectives; 3) coordinating with and providing project status reports to senior leadership and stakeholders to ensure requirements are met; and 4) applying project management principles and best practices, such as those found in the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK), to resolve critical IT project issues and implement new technologies.

The specialized experience must include, or be supplemented by, information technology related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training, as appropriate) which demonstrates each of the four competencies, as defined: (1) Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: completing thorough and accurate work independently, even in the most difficult or stressful situations; occasionally reviewing work completed by others.

(2) Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: resolving routine and non-routine problems, questions, or complaints; developing and maintaining strong, mutually supportive working relationships with customers; conducting evaluation of support to determine quality of services and customer satisfaction, and recommending procedural changes based on customer need or changes in policy and/or regulation.

(3) Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: convincingly conveying complex information to customers; presenting thoughts that are well-organized and demonstrating confidence in the facts and ideas; adjusting style when working with individuals with different levels of understanding; using various methods to explain and convey information.

(4) Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: solving complex or sensitive problems by developing and proposing strategic alternatives; identifying possible conflicts and shared benefits; helping team anticipate problems and identifying and evaluating potential sources of information; providing feedback and coaching to others to help solve problems; engaging appropriate stakeholders when developing solutions in order to understand and incorporate multiple perspectives and needs; evaluating the effectiveness of decisions and adjusting future decisions as appropriate.

Time in Grade Requirement for GS-14: Applicants who have held a General Schedule (GS) position within the last 52 weeks must have 52 weeks of Federal service at the next lower grade or equivalent (GS-13).

Agir en tant que conseiller stratégique auprès de l'équipe de direction (SMT) sur les questions liées au personnel, à l'efficacité organisationnelle, à la planification des effectifs, à la gestion des talents et au dialogue social, y compris avec les représentants syndicaux et du personnel.

Mener des initiatives de conception organisationnelle et de gestion du changement visant à renforcer l'efficacité opérationnelle, l'engagement des employés et la résilience organisationnelle.

Développer et mettre en œuvre des politiques, pratiques et initiatives en matière de ressources humaines alignées sur les valeurs, la culture et les objectifs stratégiques de PSI.

Superviser la prestation des opérations RH mondiales dans tous les sites de PSI, en garantissant cohérence, efficacité et conformité à la législation locale du travail et aux politiques organisationnelles.

Diriger et améliorer continuellement les processus liés au personnel, y compris le recrutement, l'intégration, la gestion du cycle de vie des employés, l'administration des contrats et la sortie des employés.

Assurer la conformité légale et réglementaire dans toutes les régions et bureaux pays, en atténuant les risques liés à l'emploi et en maintenant les meilleures pratiques RH. Gérer les systèmes RH mondiaux, les dossiers, les rapports et les analyses du personnel pour soutenir la prise de décisions éclairées.
**Gestion des talents & Développement des employés**
Diriger les processus mondiaux de planification des effectifs et de planification de la succession pour assurer la continuité organisationnelle et les capacités futures.

Développer et mettre en œuvre des initiatives d'apprentissage, de développement du leadership et de progression de carrière qui renforcent la performance organisationnelle et l'engagement des employés.

Superviser les processus de gestion de la performance, en veillant à ce que les managers soient équipés pour soutenir la haute performance et le développement professionnel. Promouvoir une culture d'apprentissage continu, de feedback et de responsabilité à travers l'organisation.
**Relations avec les employés, bien-être & inclusion**
Promouvoir un lieu de travail diversifié, équitable, inclusif et psychologiquement sûr où tous les employés peuvent s'épanouir. Mener des initiatives liées au bien-être des employés, à la santé et sécurité, et au devoir de diligence dans tous les sites de PSI.

Fournir des conseils experts sur des questions complexes de relations avec les employés, la résolution de conflits et les enquêtes en milieu de travail lorsque nécessaire. Favoriser un dialogue social positif et un engagement constructif avec les représentants des employés et syndicats.
**Partenariat RH**
Servir de partenaire RH mondial pour les managers et le personnel du siège, des bureaux régionaux et des bureaux pays. Soutenir les leaders dans la gestion du personnel, le développement des équipes, la gestion de la performance, la planification des effectifs et l'engagement des employés.

Coacher et conseiller les managers sur l'efficacité du leadership, les relations avec les employés, le développement des talents et le changement organisationnel. Permettre aux managers de prendre des décisions efficaces en matière de personnel grâce à des analyses basées sur les données et des conseils RH pratiques.
**Rémunération, avantages & planification des effectifs**
Diriger le développement et la révision des cadres mondiaux de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux pour garantir compétitivité, équité et alignement avec les objectifs organisationnels. Soutenir les revues salariales, la planification des effectifs et les négociations relatives aux conditions d'emploi et aux avantages du personnel.

Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe financière sur la planification des effectifs, le budget des ressources humaines, les coûts du personnel et les rapports financiers liés aux RH. Contribuer au développement de stratégies d'investissement durable en personnel qui soutiennent la croissance et l'efficacité organisationnelles.

# Program Manager - Power Unit Components #
## Our Team ##
Since the 2026 season, Audi has been competing in the FIA Formula 1 World Championship.
The new team has three locations. The Motorsport Competence Center of Audi in Neuburg (Germany) is considered one of the most modern of its kind in Europe. The Formula 1 factory of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil (Switzerland) is known for its innovative technologies and passion for racing. The Audi Motorsport Technology Center in UK is in its launch phase and growing continuously. Our Power Unit comes from Neuburg, while Hinwil is responsible for the development of the chassis and race operations.
What you need? The mindset of an athlete. If you are someone for whom giving up isn-t an option and limits are just something to be overcome, you can bring Vorsprung durch Technik to Formula 1 with us. Become part of this unique project and make motorsport history.
This position is to be filled at Audi Formula Racing GmbH in Neuburg (Germany).
In program management, we act as the central unit of Audi Formula Racing GmbH. We form the interface between the technical areas, the supply chain and the financial management of the company and are thus responsible for the complex project management for the development and production of the Audi F1 Powertrain.

We operate in a highly exciting, always time-critical and rapidly changing environment. Through intensive cooperation, we ensure transparency for the achievement of project goals and early identification of project risks. In addition to high personal standards, willingness to communicate and team performance, we also focus on enjoying our work!

Due to the dependence of many different topics in our area of responsibility, close cooperation and a high degree of openness are prerequisites for our successful work.

* Project planning and management: Responsibility for the planning, implementation and control of projects within the framework of Audi Formula 1 activities. Creation of transparency about development and supply chain processes for the Audi F1 Power Unit.
* Align and set milestones, goals, and timelines to ensure that all projects are on track to achieve overall goals.
* Cross-departmental coordination: Close cooperation with the project manager, the development teams of the Power Unit and the adjacent departments of logistics, procurement, quality assurance and workshops. Ensure a smooth flow between these teams to optimize the development cycles of the power unit components.
* Risk management: Identification of risks and proactive development of measures and proposed solutions so as not to jeopardize project results.
* Reporting: Regular reports to AFR management on the progress and status of projects.
* Continuous process optimization: Analyze and improve existing operations with a focus on program management and supply chain processes to continuously increase efficiency and performance.
* Progress monitoring and evaluation: Regularly reviewing project progress to ensure that strategic goals are being met and adjustments can be made in a timely manner if necessary.
## Your Profile ##
* Professional experience: Several years of experience in project management, preferably in the motorsport industry or in a comparably demanding environment with high dynamics and technical complexity.
* Technical understanding: A high level of understanding of the technical processes and requirements in the Formula 1 environment in order to be able to coordinate and control projects efficiently.
* Methodological skills: Sound knowledge of project management methods as well as in the areas of time and resource planning, risk management and cost control.
* Experience in project management of interdisciplinary teams and the motivation of employees in a dynamic environment.
* You have business fluency in German or English and are willing to learn basic knowledge of the other language.
* Resilience and flexibility: High resilience and the ability to deliver high-quality results under high pressure in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
* Problem-solving skills: Strong ability to analyze complex problems and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.
* International experience: Willingness to travel as well as intercultural competence to operate effectively in a global environment.
